name: Customer deposits
description: Retail and corporate deposits across current, savings and term products. Concentration risk + financial-crime entry point.

name: Lending portfolio
description: Retail, SME and corporate lending. Credit risk, fraud, money-mule conduit.

name: SEPA / SWIFT / cards / instant rails
description: Inbound and outbound payment rails — sanctions screening, fraud, AML, settlement risk.

name: Correspondent / nostro relationships
description: Other banks you settle through or for. Heightened AML/sanctions risk, EBA correspondent guidance.

name: PEP / high-risk customers
description: Politically exposed persons, high-risk-jurisdiction nationals, complex beneficial ownership.

name: Market / treasury trading desk
description: Bank's own trading book — market abuse, mis-selling, conduct risk.
